name: Integrated Care Association for Special Needs
subject: Special education specialist interested in ICAN Kuwait
body:
Dear ICAN team,

Integrated care, with teachers, therapists and families working on the same goals, is how I have always approached students with special needs. I am writing to ask about roles on your team.

- Managed a resource room and an IEP for each student for seven years.
- Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities in a public school for the first time.
- Delivered training for teachers and parents on behavior modification and ADHD.

I hold an MA in Special Education (Excellent). My CV is attached.

Kind regards,
